fields.title: Check boundaries
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: The system is split into services: users, catalog, cart, orders, payment, delivery, notifications. For each task, state how many services are touched and evaluate the boundaries.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Show time until delivery on order card
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — one, good. 2 — payment plus orders for display, two, acceptable. 3 — orders and delivery; if via cross-service call on every open — bad, if via snapshot on event — good. 4 — users, orders, delivery, notifications: four, a sign that the phone was duplicated without an owner, not a sign of bad service boundaries. Rule of thumb: a typical task should fit within a single service.
